title: Non-abelian Hodge correspondence over singular Kähler spaces
summary: In this paper, we establish the non-abelian Hodge correspondence over compact Kähler spaces with Kawamata log terminal (klt) singularities as well as over their regular loci, thereby extending the result of Greb-Kebekus-Peternell-Taji for projective klt varieties to the context of compact Kähler klt spaces.
